record.question: The local extinction of a species is known as:
record.explanation: Answer D: Extirpation. Extirpation means local extinction within a particular area while the species survives elsewhere. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/science/extinction-biology. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
